channel.title: TaxCode x US Stocks x AI | Jeff
channel.description: US stock analysis through an international tax lens, plus AI-automated research workflows. The tax layer you're missing in US stock investing.

item.title: How I Direct AI: A Hands-On Case
item.description: Four days of flagship-model access and a scarce quota: the AI audited my delegation design, flagged four traps, and the layering was rebuilt around leverage of judgment, with the final sign-off staying human.

item.title: Taiwan's 183-day rule: when foreigners become tax residents, and what happens to offshore investments
item.description: How the days are counted, the four-step legal chain that pulls offshore income into Taiwan's minimum tax at 183 days, and the three details expats miss.

item.title: How I built an AI-powered investment research pipeline: from filings to conclusions
item.description: Python pulls the data, AI deep-reads the filings, and multi-source cross-checks guard against hallucination. A research workflow in daily use, tools and rules fully public.

item.title: Apple's tax code, decoded: ETR spiked from 14.7% to 24.1%, then settled at 15.6%
item.description: Five years of effective tax rate in one read: four structural drivers, the USD 10.2B EU State Aid one-off, and the new normal under Pillar Two.

item.title: Build your own 13F tracker: free automation with Python + SEC EDGAR
item.description: Skip the subscription fees: pull Buffett's and Burry's position changes straight from SEC source data. Full SOP with code, plus the pitfalls beginners hit.

item.title: Will the 15% global minimum tax hit your Irish-domiciled ETF?
item.description: Ireland raised its rate under the OECD global minimum tax, so will VWRA or CSPX get caught? A three-layer test: the fund is not taxed; the real effect sits in the holdings.

item.title: Is overseas income under NT$7.5M tax-free? The five most common myths for US stock investors, dismantled
item.description: The NT$1M threshold is a cliff not a floor, the NT$7.5M deduction does not come off overseas income alone, and crossing it does not always mean paying. Five myths with worked examples.

item.title: SK Hynix is coming to Nasdaq (SKHY): should Taiwan investors buy the ADR or the Korean shares?
item.description: Treaty 10% vs statutory 22% dividend withholding, capital gains on both sides, and estate tax on both the ADR and the Korean shares.

item.title: US Treasuries are exempt from US estate tax, but Treasury ETFs are taxed: what nonresident investors must know
item.description: Hold T-Bills directly and they sit outside the US estate tax. Wrap the same Treasuries in a US-listed ETF and the shares become taxable US-situs assets.

item.title: TSM ADR vs the Taiwan-listed share: the two tax questions most people get wrong
item.description: Is the 21% dividend withholding recoverable? Is a TSM ADR a US-situs estate tax asset? The issuer test settles both.

item.title: The tax most foreign investors in US stocks overlook: the USD 60,000 estate tax threshold
item.description: US citizens get a USD 15M exemption; nonresident aliens get USD 60,000. What counts as US-situs, the correct computation, and three planning routes.
